title: Past perfect continuous: had been working

rule.title: Past perfect continuous
rule.explanation:
El past perfect continuous («had been» + «-ing») describe una actividad que duró hasta un momento del pasado, o justo antes. Sirve mucho para explicar causas:
- «Daniel was exhausted because he had been working until midnight.»
- «Her eyes were red. She had been crying.»

Con «for» / «since» dice cuánto tiempo llevaba pasando:
- «We had been testing the site for three weeks when we launched it.»
- «How long had you been waiting when the bus came?»

Compáralo con el past perfect simple, que mira el resultado o el número de veces:
- «I had checked the files twice.» (resultado)
- «I had been checking the files all morning.» (actividad, duración)

Los verbos de estado («know», «be», «have» como posesión, «want», «believe») van en past perfect simple (nunca «had been knowing»):
- «I had known Helen for years.»

Ojo: es el pasado del present perfect continuous: «I've been waiting for an hour» (ahora) → «I had been waiting for an hour» (cuando pasó algo).

rows: He was tired because he had been running.
We had been living there for years.
I had known her since school.
